exposure: continuity of care (personal continuity from community midwives, team continuity, presence of a coordinating care professional)
use of a maternity care plan
cohort: The study included 1165 pregnant women in the Netherlands who were beyond 32 weeks gestation.
finding: Most women reported moderate-to-high levels of perceived quality of antenatal care, with personal continuity from community midwives, team continuity, and the presence of a coordinating care professional being associated with higher perceived quality.
